definitions.short: destructive , i.e. (as noun) destruction , literally (specifically a snare) or figuratively (corruption)
definitions.full: H4889. mashchith מַשְׁחִית noun [masculine] ruin, destruction ; — ׳מ absolute Jer 5:26 10 t.; — physical destruction Ezek 5:16 ; 9:6 ; Ezekiel 21:36; 25:15 ; Exod 12:13 (P), 2Chr 20:23 ; 22:4 ; מ ׳בַּעַל Prov 18:9 = destroyer ; Dan 10:8 (disfigurement); ׳הַרמֿ Jer 51:25 (figurative of Babylonian as destroyer), in 2Kin 23:13 = mountain of corruption (where bamoth were, southern end of Mt. of Olives, possibly adapted from הַרמִֿשְׁחָה so Hoffm ZAW ii (1882), 175 Benz Kit Bur; ᵑ9 mons offensionis ).

occurrences.englishText: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.

For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
“Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says Yahweh,
when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you, and will break your staff of bread.
Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.”
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility;”
So I was left alone, and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.
